subject: VMWARE_ESXI_REFERENCE_GOVERNANCE
statement: The repository can mechanically trace every VMware experiment from Tech Story to representative run and hash-bound evidence, and can derive non-closing acceptance associations from requiredTechStories.
limitations: Historical pyVmomi task identifiers and initiating actors are not uniformly retained.
Historical VMware runs do not all conform to contracts/vmware-experiment-result.schema.json.
Representative run IDs do not imply that every legacy case has a canonical result.
This reference-governance result cannot close a Qman product case, risk, implementation milestone, qualification profile, or release gate.
